entries.text: ECS tasks in private subnets need outbound access: add a NAT gateway or VPC endpoints for ECR, CloudWatch Logs and Secrets Manager, otherwise tasks cannot start.

run.input_text: Deploy a containerized Python REST API on AWS ECS Fargate in eu-central-1. Traffic comes from the internet over HTTPS through an Application Load Balancer with an existing ACM certificate (pass the ARN as a variable). The containers run in private subnets across two availability zones and pull the image from Amazon ECR. The API uses a PostgreSQL database on Amazon RDS in private subnets, with automated backups and encryption at rest. Store the database password in AWS Secrets Manager. Enable autoscaling between 2 and 6 tasks based on CPU usage. Send container logs to CloudWatch Logs. Expected load is about 200 requests per second at peak. Keep the monthly cost reasonable for a small company.

network.notes: Public traffic enters via the ALB and is routed to the Fargate tasks. The database and container registry remain in private subnets with no inbound internet exposure.
